description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution across two components of the Paper Copilot system, with the total time divided into two segments: "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The "Reduction" segment, represented by a large orange slice, accounts for 60.9 seconds, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total time. The "Efficient deployment" segment, shown in blue, represents 26.2 seconds, or 30.08% of the total. The chart visually emphasizes the "Reduction" component as the dominant portion, with the "Efficient deployment" slice slightly separated from the main circle, indicating its distinct contribution. The percentages and time values are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart uses a simple color scheme to differentiate the two categories.
